page_title: ATM 2-1 RAY | Atletico Madrid v Rayo Vallecano 31/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Cesar Soto Grado has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is given a yellow card.
90+2' Diego Simeone appears to have said too much and referee Cesar Soto Grado comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
90+1' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Francisco, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
90+1' Referee Cesar Soto Grado points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) goes wild in celebration.
90+1' Wait! Referee Cesar Soto Grado has indicated he is going to review the Atl. Madrid goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Antoine Griezmann plays it into the box, and Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
88' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Antoine Griezmann, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
86' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
85' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
83' Here is a change. Sergio Camello is going off and Francisco gives the last tactical orders to Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano).
83' The goal by Atl. Madrid won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
82' The Atl. Madrid players halt their celebrations as referee Cesar Soto Grado makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
81' Goal! A great through ball by Pablo Barrios sets up Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
81' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
79' Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
78' Great teamplay by Atl. Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
76' Francisco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Isi Palazon.
76' A substitution has been made. Alvaro Garcia is replaced by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
75' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
73' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
73' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Rayo Vallecano force a corner. They send men into the box.
69' Today's match ends for Saul Niguez who will be replaced by Koke (Atl. Madrid).

65' Ooh that was close! Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kike Perez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano).
64' Francisco prepares a substitution. Andrei Ratiu is replaced by Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano).

64' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
60' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Cesar Soto Grado and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
58' Marcos Llorente goes off the pitch and Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
58' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) replaces Rodrigo Riquelme.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Angel Correa departs the field of play to be replaced by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
54' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
53' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
51' The Atl. Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
48' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is behind the touchline and Rayo Vallecano will take a throw-in.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Diego Simeone gives a chance to Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) and Arthur Vermeeren is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Arthur Vermeeren (Atl. Madrid) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Stole Dimitrievski comes off the line to clear the ball away.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

42' 1 - 1 Stunning strike! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) latches on to a precise through ball from Pep Chavarria before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:1.
41' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

41' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
38' It must be a yellow card. It is. Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
37' Referee Cesar Soto Grado points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Reinildo (Atl. Madrid) goes wild in celebration.
37' The Atl. Madrid players halt their celebrations as referee Cesar Soto Grado makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

35' 1 - 0 Perfectly taken free kick! Rodrigo Riquelme sends a cross in and Reinildo (Atl. Madrid) leaps high to connect with it on the edge of the 6-yard box. His close-range header goes inside the right post and he makes it 1:0.

34' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
33' The resulting corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is cleared.
32' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. Rayo Vallecano get a corner.
30' The goal is ruled out after the referee indicates that the VAR spotted Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) was offside!
29' Referee Cesar Soto Grado makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand. Let’s see what happens!
29' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
26' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) works the corner short.
25' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Rayo Vallecano force their opponents to concede a corner.
24' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

24' Stole Dimitrievski pulls off a great save to deny Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! The ball is out of play and Atl. Madrid manage to earn a corner.

23' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.

20' Great chance! Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) controls a rebound inside the box. He only has the keeper to beat, but his shot flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
18' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stole Dimitrievski intercepts the ball.
16' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
13' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

13' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Rayo Vallecano force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
11' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) meets a cross inside the box, but Stole Dimitrievski wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
9' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
7' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging some short passes.
4' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
3' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul and Cesar Soto Grado immediately signals a free kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Rayo Vallecano will take the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
